name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian Tan's journey into motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional. Originally trained as an accountant, she found herself drawn to the high-octane world of racing after volunteering at the Singapore Grand Prix during its inaugural year. The speed and precision required, both on and off the track, resonated with her meticulous nature.

At Erebus Motorsport, Mei Lian is responsible for managing the team's budget, ensuring financial compliance, and identifying opportunities for cost-effectiveness. She believes in a transparent and collaborative approach, working closely with all departments to understand their needs and challenges. Her ability to remain calm under pressure and her unwavering commitment to accuracy make her an invaluable asset to the team. She's known for her ability to find savings where others see none, a skill she honed during her early career working with small businesses.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a side parting.
physical.description: Mei Lian is of average height with a warm, approachable smile and wears rectangular-framed glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations, despite having a powerful laptop.
Insists on using color-coded spreadsheets for everything, even casual expense reports.
Prefers to take meetings standing up, believing it keeps everyone focused and efficient.
